config.hint: Routing, concurrency, and cooldown settings for the OpenRouter free-model racer.
config.routingHint: How many free models race per round and how many rounds a request may use.
config.timeoutsHint: Failure cooldowns skip a model temporarily; timeouts bound how long a round may wait.
config.baseUrlHint: Leave empty for https://openrouter.ai/api/v1. Override only for testing.
config.raceWidthHint: Each round fires this many candidates; first to stream wins. More width trades quota for lower latency.
config.maxBatchesHint: Up to raceWidth × maxBatches unique models are tried before giving up.
config.exhaustedTtlHint: How long a 429/5xx/400/422 model is skipped.
config.slowTtlHint: Short cooldown for models that timed out before the first token.
config.firstTokenTimeoutHint: Batch 1 deadline; later batches loosen to 1.5×/2×.
config.idleTimeoutHint: Abort the winning stream after this much silence.
config.refreshHint: How often to re-fetch OpenRouter's free model list.
config.authHint: Get a free key at openrouter.ai/keys. Prefer the provider credential (PUT /v1/providers/free-router/credential); this field is a fallback.
config.apiKeyHint: Saved to the freerouter provider credential on save; the model appears in the picker right away. Get a free key at openrouter.ai/keys.
config.keySaveFailed: Could not save the provider credential; the key was stored in the extension config instead.
config.listenHint: Always-on Chat Completions proxy bind address. Default 127.0.0.1:18427. Changing it requires reloading the extension.
